title: Governed database lifecycle and pressure relief contracts

phases.objective: Publish a complete, secret-free, contract-only Spec Kit with deterministic safety boundaries and a multi-PR implementation plan.

e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The lifecycle contract is complete, bounded, secret-free, and does not authorize runtime mutation.
steps: Load the Spec 019 documents and JSON schemas.
Verify the lifecycle stages, domain decisions, authority boundaries, receipts, readback, and error taxonomy.
Reject arbitrary SQL, wildcard authority, silent retention, and destructive defaults.
Report deterministic contract validation without contacting Production.
assertions: The Spec Kit contains specification, plan, tasks, data model, operations, research, threat model, checklists, contracts, E2E, and Work Map artifacts.
Engine runs remain plan-only when retention policy is missing.
Logical cleanup and physical reclaim are separate contracts.
No secrets or production mutation authority are included.

phases.objective: Implement read-only pressure observation, domain classification, and deterministic lifecycle planning without database mutation.

e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The observer receives pressure metrics, largest tables, growth estimate, policy coverage, domain classifications, and immutable review plans; no write or execution authority is produced.
steps: Load bounded table and capacity observations through SELECT-only adapters.
Normalize and sort table evidence deterministically.
Classify response chunks, repo audit findings, engine runs, and unknown resources by domain semantics.
Resolve approved policy metadata or return a blocking policy result.
Build an immutable fingerprinted review plan with exact resource and recipe requirements.
Return read-only safety markers and separate logical cleanup versus physical reclaim estimates.
assertions: Missing quota yields capacity_unknown rather than an invented 100 percent pressure value.
Reordering candidates does not change plan fingerprint.
Unknown retention and missing policy fail closed.
Engine execution runs remain execution_allowed=false without archive policy.
The collector executes SELECT-only SQL and always returns will_write=false and will_execute=false.

phases.objective: Add exact authority, durable receipts, bounded execution, reconciliation, and preservation-invariant tests.
Run the response-chunk pilot in non-production with fixed cutoff, readback, and rollback evidence.
Promote only after staging/canary/readback, security, performance, migration, and owner approval gates.
